segments.tha-ap291:1.1: “Veṭambhinīti [veṭambarīti (sī.), vedhambhinīti (syā.)] me nāmaṃ, pitusantaṃ [pitā’ santaṃ (?)] mamaṃ tadā;
segments.tha-ap291:2.3: Tehaṃ upaṭṭhiṃ sakkaccaṃ, pasanno sehi pāṇibhi.
segments.tha-ap291:3.1: “Ekattiṃse ito kappe, buddhe upaṭṭhahiṃ [paricariṃ (sī. syā.)] tadā;
segments.tha-ap291:6.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā buddhupaṭṭhāyiko thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthāti.
